_note: E9 passwords attack fragment (awareness). A fragment of the `social` block; the wiring agent copies people, intelFacts and osint into scenarios/awareness_e9_passwords/scenario.json.erb (01 P2), with the `_` notes stripped. The attack half is the OSINT stage (collect Colin Mather's public details as facts) followed by the `guess` stage (ENG-02), whose config block lives in full_only.json at social.awarenessEpisode.guess (episode-level, full-only; see E09_passwords.md section 9 and the note in full_only.json). There is no mail send, no landing page, no template set and no phishTarget: the guesser is the attack artefact. Nothing typed is a real password. Colin Mather and the company are fictional (BRAND_SET.md, Tarrowby Logistics); every domain ends .example.
_factValueNote: The ENG-02 guesser interpolates each pattern slot's brace token with its fact's guess value. ENG-02's spec names only factId + template per slot and does not state where the token value is read. Each guess-feeding fact below carries that value in provides[0] (type 'guessToken', value = the exact string the template interpolates: 'Pennington', 'Bramble', '1994'), following the osint intelFacts provides shape (E8). If ENG-02 reads the token from somewhere else, point it here; see E09_passwords.md section 20 and the note to the wiring agent.

tarrowby_mather_role.text: Colin Mather is Tarrowby's warehouse manager.
tarrowby_mather_role.subject: colin
tarrowby_mather_role.reduceNote: A named manager on the public team page gives an attacker a specific person to guess a password for.

tarrowby_mather_team.text: Colin posts about supporting Pennington Rangers every Saturday.
tarrowby_mather_team.subject: colin
tarrowby_mather_team.reduceNote: A favourite team is one of the first things a guesser tries, and he posts his every week.

tarrowby_mather_pet.text: Colin's photos of his dog Bramble.
tarrowby_mather_pet.subject: colin
tarrowby_mather_pet.reduceNote: A pet's name is a classic password and an easy one to lift from a public photo caption.

tarrowby_founded.text: Tarrowby Logistics has run from the same West Yorkshire depot since 1994.
tarrowby_founded.subject: company
tarrowby_founded.reduceNote: The founding year on the about page is the digits a guesser adds to the company name or the team.

tarrowby_mather_forum.text: Colin mentions he has been on the RiverReach Angling forum for years.
tarrowby_mather_forum.subject: colin
tarrowby_mather_forum.reduceNote: A small hobby site he's used for years is just the sort of place that gets breached and whose password gets reused at work.
